title: "Living for the World Will Cost You Eternity – Choose Wisely" 🔥
paragraphs: "Living for the World Will Cost You Eternity – Choose Wisely" 🔥

🔥 YOU CAN HAVE THE WORLD OR YOU CAN HAVE JESUS… BUT YOU CAN’T HAVE BOTH.
⚠️ Many claim to follow Jesus, yet their hearts still belong to the world.
❌ They chase success, money, and pleasure—but ignore prayer, holiness, and obedience.
❌ They want Heaven, but they don’t want to give up their sin.
❌ They love God with their lips, but their actions prove otherwise.
🚨 The Bible makes it clear—you CANNOT serve two masters!
📖 "Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him." (1 John 2:15)
🔥 If you are living for the world, you are trading eternity for temporary pleasure.

🔥 1. YOU CAN’T SERVE JESUS AND STILL LOVE THE WORLD
📖 "No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other." (Matthew 6:24)
🚨 Many try to live with one foot in the church and one foot in the world… but Jesus REJECTS lukewarm Christianity!

🔥 WARNING SIGNS YOU LOVE THE WORLD MORE THAN GOD:
❌ You care more about money and success than growing in Christ.
❌ You make time for Netflix, social media, and entertainment—but no time for prayer.
❌ You hide your faith because you care what people think.
❌ You talk like the world, act like the world, and think like the world.
❌ You feel no conviction when you sin—you just make excuses.
💀 If any of these describe you, it’s time to repent and turn back to Jesus!
📖 "Whoever wishes to be a friend of the world makes himself an ENEMY of God." (James 4:4)
🚨 Are you a friend of the world or a true follower of Christ?

🔥 2. SATAN WANTS YOU TO CHOOSE TEMPORARY PLEASURE OVER ETERNAL LIFE
📖 "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?" (Mark 8:36)

🚨 SATAN’S GREATEST TRAP:
💰 He will give you money, success, and pleasure—if it keeps you away from God.
🎥 He will fill your life with entertainment, distractions, and sin—so you never seek Jesus.
⚠️ He will make sin feel “fun” now—so you suffer forever later.
🔥 HELL WILL BE FULL OF PEOPLE WHO LOVED THIS WORLD MORE THAN THEY LOVED GOD.
📖 "The world is passing away along with its desires, but whoever does the will of God remains forever." (1 John 2:17)
🚨 DON’T TRADE ETERNITY FOR SOMETHING THAT WON’T LAST!

🔥 3. HOW TO BREAK FREE FROM WORLDLINESS AND LIVE FOR JESUS
📖 "Set your minds on things above, not on things that are on earth." (Colossians 3:2)
🚀 It’s time to fully commit to Jesus and stop chasing the world. Here’s how:

✅ 1. REPENT OF ANYTHING THAT HAS TAKEN GOD’S PLACE.
📖 "Repent and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped away." (Acts 3:19)

✅ 2. REMOVE DISTRACTIONS THAT PULL YOU AWAY FROM JESUS.
📖 "Lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely." (Hebrews 12:1)

✅ 3. SPEND TIME WITH GOD DAILY – NOT JUST WHEN YOU NEED SOMETHING.
📖 "Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you." (James 4:8)

✅ 4. STOP BEING ASHAMED OF JESUS – BOLDLY LIVE FOR HIM.
📖 "Whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny before My Father in heaven." (Matthew 10:33)
🔥 JESUS GAVE HIS LIFE FOR YOU—WILL YOU LIVE FULLY FOR HIM?

🔥 THE ETERNAL CHOICE CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your life—what do you need to give up for Jesus?
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this truth before it’s too late!

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 22, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I come before You today and surrender my heart. If I have been living for the world instead of You, I repent. I choose to follow Jesus with ALL my heart, no more excuses. Lord, remove anything in my life that is keeping me from You. Set me on fire for You, and help me to stay faithful until the end. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
